headline: SPX FLOW deal costs mask strong underlying growth
summary_short: ITT's Q1 2026 revenue rose 32.7% y/y to $1,211.9M on the SPX FLOW acquisition and 10.9% organic growth, but GAAP net income fell 28.0% y/y to $78.0M ($0.89 diluted EPS) on $67.5M of acquisition-related costs and added intangible amortization; adjusted EPS of $1.98 rose 25.3% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue grew 32.7% y/y to $1,211.9M: $151.4M from the SPX FLOW acquisition, $47.8M FX, plus 10.9% organic growth led by FT pump projects, CCT aerospace/defense strength, and MT Friction OE. GAAP operating income fell 6.4% y/y to $141.2M on $67.5M acquisition costs and $12.7M added intangible amortization; adjusted operating income rose 41.7%. Net income fell 28.0% y/y to $78.0M ($0.89 diluted EPS; adjusted $1.98, +25.3%) on acquisition costs and a higher 38.3% effective tax rate. Operating cash flow fell to $39.9M on acquisition transaction costs. Long-term debt rose to $3,375M and equity to $4,738M, both reflecting SPX FLOW financing and equity issuance. No forward guidance was given in this 10-Q.
